text: LLM Leaderboard - Comparison of AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, SpaceXAI & others Comparison and ranking the performance of over 250 AI models (LLMs) across key metrics including intelligence, price, performance and speed (output speed - tokens per second & latency - TTFT), context window & others. For more details including relating to our methodology, see our FAQs. Intelligence Updated Claude Opus 5.5 (max with fallback) and Claude Opus 5.5 (xhigh with fallback) are the highest intelligence models, followed by Claude Opus 5.5 (high with fallback) and Claude Fable 5.1 (max with fallback). [图标][图标][图标][图标] Output Speed Celeris-1 and Mercury 2 are the fastest models, followed by Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite. [图标][图标][图标][图标] Latency Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (Non-reasoning) and North Mini Code are the lowest latency models, followed by Command A+ and Gemini 2.5 Flash (Non-reasoning). [图标][图标][图标][图标] Cost per Task GPT-6 Luna (low) and Granite 4.2 3B have the lowest cost per task, followed by GPT-5.6 Luna (low) and GPT-5.6 Luna (Non-reasoning). [图标][图标][图标][图标] Context Window Llama 4 Scout and Grok 4.20 0309 support the largest context windows, followed by Gemini 1.5 Pro (May) and Grok 4.1 Fast.
